reason: ₹22,000 is a quarter of what we earn in a whole year, and the EMI of ₹2,000 every month is more than I can promise. A plain semi-automatic costs about half, and hand-washing costs nothing, so I will keep washing by hand.
objection: It is a premium machine for people with money. With my small solar system and weak grid I am not sure the battery even charges properly, and adding ₹6,500 for a panel makes it nearly ₹28,500.
would_change_my_mind: If the full price with the solar panel came close to a normal semi-automatic, around ₹10,000-12,000, or the EMI dropped to a few hundred rupees a month.
